name: Sticky Grid Scroll
description: A pinned 3-column image grid that staggers in, scales and opens up, and reveals an overlaid title and CTA at precise scroll points before releasing.
usage: Mark up .sgs > .sgs-stage > (.sgs-grid with three .sgs-col / .sgs-cell columns + a [data-sgs-content] overlay), include styles.css, then call initStickyGridScroll(). Lenis is auto-detected; pass { lenis: false } to opt out.
license: Inspired by a Codrops/Tympanus tutorial (free for personal & commercial use) — reimplemented cleanly, no verbatim source.
